name: Windows 11
intro: Free and open-source applications whose official project sources state support for Windows 11 in the current release.

name: Windows 10
intro: Free and open-source applications whose official project sources state support for Windows 10 in the current release.

name: Windows 7
intro: Free and open-source applications whose official project sources state that the current release works on Windows 7. Many modern applications no longer support Windows 7, so this list is intentionally short.
